android-phone-emulator.description: Colony core of the red colony: both swimming pools and both racetracks whole, with barracks, inns, hospitals and hundreds of globs
About thirty red warriors meet some twenty blue defenders on the blue colony's ground, two war flags in the fight
A different part of the colony: inns, hospitals and a Swarm busy with globs, no event rows
Build palette open over the live colony between the lake and a swimming pool
Inn selected: Food 47/50 and its fruit stock, beside the algae lake, a wheat field and workers; a Swarm behind the priority dial
Flags palette open at the front: a war flag just placed, a red line facing a blue line
A second map, FourSquares1: the red colony on its island beside the algae-covered sea, sand and violet forest
